messages:
maria: Quick design check — empty state for the Sessions table. Copy feels a bit vague and keyboard focus order is off when you tab in. Can someone eyeball? Figma: https://figma.redwood/sessions-empty (mock) ken: I agree on the copy. Current: "No sessions yet" -> sounds passive. Proposal: "Create your first session to start routing requests". Shorter option for small screens: "Create a session". Thoughts? :thinking_face: alex: Copy suggestions look fine, but accessibility note: when the page loads with no sessions the primary CTA should be the first focusable element. Right now the search input is focused first which is confusing for keyboard users. Also add aria-describedby on the CTA pointing to the helper text for context. sam: From PM side — prefer the slightly longer "Create your first session to start routing requests" because it sets expectation. But keep the button text shorter: "Create session". Also consider translation length; keep text under ~30 chars if possible. maria: Agreed on split (helper sentence + compact CTA). UX nit: helper sentence should be visible to screen readers even if visually hidden on narrow screens. Also prefer the helper copy to avoid jargon — replace "routing requests" with "send traffic" maybe. ken: Quick DOM suggestion to make the CTA first in tab order without moving DOM: set tabindex="0" on the CTA and tabindex="-1" on the search when empty. Example: ```

Create your first session to start sending traffic to a model.

``` alex: That approach works but be careful with aria-hidden on interactive elements — better to move DOM order or manage focus with JS on load. If you must use tabindex, ensure screen readers still announce helper text: add `aria-describedby="empty-helper"` to the button. maria: Updated copy proposal (final draft): Helper: "Create your first session to start sending traffic to a model." Button: "Create session" Link under helper: "Learn about sessions" (opens doc). Anyone object? sam: no objections, please file a tiny spec + acceptance criteria in the ticket: 1) helper present & readable to SRs, 2) CTA is first focus target on empty state, 3) localization checks passed, 4) tests for keyboard nav. ken: I'll push a small PR with the markup and add a unit test for focus order. Will @maria for design sign-off once ready. maria: thanks. @ui-bot can you add a comment on the ticket with the final wording and the Figma frame id? ui-bot: Note added to ticket #4321: helper copy and CTA text updated per thread. Figma frame: figma://frame/sessions-empty/42. (auto-note) alex: one last a11y tiny nit — color contrast for the helper link should meet AA. I’ll add the token values in the PR review. :white_check_mark: maria: Awesome, thanks everyone. Moving to implement. :rocket:
